impact.text: Should a vulnerability or other issue arise with one of the vaults, then this prevents its removal or replacement, because only one vault per asset is permitted.

precondition_sources.text: A vault is registered for an asset by the share token owner, and only one vault per asset is permitted.
A vulnerability or other issue arises with one of the registered vaults, motivating its removal or replacement.

intent_sources.text: An administrator should be able to retire a registered vault even when its asset balance is nonzero.
